title: Evidence flow rebuilt to stay stable
details: Property Maintenance practical repairs now open their real evidence stages one at a time
The staged screen is shown before Evia's underlying evidence page changes, removing the visible page jump between stages
Photo capture stays 1:1, captures directly from the live camera frame, then goes straight to the required explanation
Guided video remains one continuous recording with audio, Next prompt timestamps and optional extra text afterwards
Unfinished accepted media and the current stage stay on the device so the learner can return later
Evidence download preparation no longer inserts an expanding status card that moves the signature screen
summary: Evia v133 rebuilds the staged evidence handoff so Property Maintenance and the capture flow stay stable inside Evia.
changes: Moved staged interception ahead of the legacy evidence render
Kept the original Evia learner screen hidden underneath while staged evidence is active
Optimised square photo capture for faster Android shutter response
Preserved the original evidence store and course progress updates
Moved the offline shell to v133
